## Problem

What is broken or missing. Link the backlog item.

## Approach

What this does, and any decision a reader would otherwise have to reverse-engineer.

## Where this is weak

Say it here rather than letting a reviewer find it: the case you did not cover, the
assumption you made, the thing you would do differently with more time. A pull request
that claims to be flawless is harder to review, not easier.

## Checks

- [ ] `./scripts/task check` is green locally
- [ ] the backlog item's acceptance criteria are ticked, or it says why not
- [ ] a bug fix arrives with the test that would have caught it
